facts.text_en: The pit is over 4 km wide and 1,200 m deep; open-pit mining began in 1899 and more than 17 million tonnes of copper have been removed.
facts.text_es: El rajo tiene mas de 4 km de ancho y 1.200 m de profundidad; la mineria a rajo abierto comenzo en 1899 y se han extraido mas de 17 millones de toneladas de cobre.

facts.text_en: Bench heights are 16 to 25 m and about half a million tonnes of material are removed daily.
facts.text_es: Los bancos miden entre 16 y 25 m y se retiran cerca de medio millon de toneladas de material al dia.
